title: Garmin 七成生意被手機打趴？營收憑什麼還翻一倍｜奇聞檔案局｜CC字幕
description:
流傳的版本是：手機的免費導航，打趴了 Garmin 七成的生意。
「被手機打趴」標明是流傳的版本：年報同時點名新車選配導航，二〇〇九年還有景氣與價格戰，手機造成成長停止是 Garmin 自己在年報裡的說法。Counterpoint 的智慧手錶排名只是 2022 年第一季、經 9to5Mac 轉述；全年約 81.5 億美元是公司自己的預估。每個數字的出處列在下方參考資料。

這一集翻開它 2008 到 2025 年度之間的年報，看那句「可能拖慢成長」是哪一天改成「已經讓成長停止」的、它自己做的那支手機怎麼了、同一天公布的另一個數字是什麼，還有營收要等幾年才追回來。

本集插圖由 AI 生成，裡面的人物與機器都是一般化的卡通造型，不是真實人物或真實產品。本頻道跟 Garmin 沒有授權或合作關係。

en.title: Did Phones Crush 70% of Garmin's Business? So How Did Revenue Double｜Curio Files
en.description:
The story goes: free navigation on phones crushed 70% of Garmin's business. This episode opens its annual reports for fiscal 2008 through 2025 to see the day "could slow our growth" became "has caused our growth to stop," what happened to the phone it built itself, the other number it published that same day, and how many years revenue took to catch up.

"Crushed by phones" is marked as the popular version: the same reports also name built-in navigation in new cars, and 2009 also brought the recession and a price war. That phones stopped its growth is Garmin's own wording in its annual report. The Counterpoint smartwatch ranking covers only Q1 2022, as reported by 9to5Mac; the full-year figure of about $8.15 billion is the company's own forecast. The source of every number is listed in the references below.

The illustrations in this episode are AI-generated; the people and devices in them are generic cartoon designs, not real people or real products. This channel has no license or partnership with Garmin.
